newsitem.title: UK: Rexam sells US paper mill to Wausau.
newsitem.headline: Rexam sells US paper mill to Wausau.

text.p: British materials and packaging group Rexam Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell the assets and operations of its U.S. unit Otis Specialty Papers of Maine to Wausau Paper Mills Co for some 36 million stg.

The disposal, and that of a much smaller Indonesian unit called PT Rexam Mulox to Bulkpak Pte Ltd, form part of a planned divestment programme announced last year and intended to shed businesses wih a combined annual turnover of 303 million stg.
Otis, a manufacturer of base papers for industrial processes, had turnover of 54 million stg, Rexam said.
Rexam Mulox, based in Batam, Indonesia, has been sold for 1.3 million stg, subject to net asset adjustment.
Its turnover in the last calendar year was 6.0 million stg.

Commenting on the sales, Rexam finance director Michael Hartnall said, "the level of interest that it has experienced in the remaining businesses for sale underlines Rexam's belief that those businesses have the potential to be valuable contributors to new parent companies".
